1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, __wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from both a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, and wherein the control means is further arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and to control braking force based thereon__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __plural first valves and plural second valves, wherein the plural first valves and plural second valves are arranged to operate in a coordinated manner to provide redundant braking control__.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves comprise __at least one larger valve arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and at least one smaller valve arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, wherein the larger and smaller valves are operatively distinct in their flow capacity and response characteristics__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the __at least one smaller valve is arranged to operate at high speed and to provide fine pressure modulation__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by __binary actuators that are controlled by the control means to provide discrete on-off valve actuation__.

6. (Original) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and __to dynamically control braking force based thereon in real-time__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __wherein the control means performs continuous monitoring and adjustment of braking force to maintain the optimum speed__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising __at least two units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, wherein the at least two units operate in parallel with independent control means__.
